body.statement: For \(\kappa_n\le1/16\), \[2[1-\alpha-4\sqrt{\tau_n}]_+\le L_n^\star(\kappa_n)\le2(1-\alpha).\] Hence \(\tau_n\to0\) implies \(L_n^\star(\kappa_n)\to2(1-\alpha)\). If \(s>1\) is fixed and \(\lambda_n\) remains in a compact subset of \((0,\infty)\), then the same limit holds.
body.justification: This identifies an exact nonshrinking phase and removes a spurious higher-smoothness transition based only on location entropy.
body.gap: Mikusheva (2010) links weak-instrument test power to confidence-set length, while the banked parent obtained only a two-label location mixture; neither yields the full-label coefficient \(2(1-\alpha)\) in this unknown-cutoff class.
body.consumer: An analyst can recognize regimes in which any apparently narrow interval must owe its informativeness to restrictions stronger than the maintained H\"older class.
